audit_items.proof_trace: All three user-controlled redirect inputs (oauth_redirect cookie, next query param, oauth_redirect_client cookie) pass through a try/catch URL-parse normalization (L30-49, L52-61) that extracts only pathname+search when the input is a valid absolute URL; for values that fail URL parsing (e.g. protocol-relative '//evil.com'), the final guard at L65 prepends the server-constructed origin, yielding a same-authority URL (e.g. https://app.example.com//evil.com) which is not an open redirect. The httpOnly oauth_redirect cookie is always set server-side as pathname+search and never carries an absolute URL.
